inventory.notes: One donkey with red glasses and pink bandana, no tack; four legs counted; one easel; one teal cable to one small pale server tower on the horizon. Tool: feather quill, ink pot on the ground. Canvas: rows of ragged gray scribble. No text or logos. Inspected at 554px on a contact sheet and at 72px, not on quadrant crops.

orientation.notes: Donkey in profile facing right, sitting on his haunches, hind hooves and one front hoof on the ground, other front hoof raised; canvas content follows the canvas's three-quarter perspective inside its edges.

contact.notes: Grounded hooves sit on the ground shadow; the raised hoof holds: feather quill, ink pot on the ground; easel legs on the ground; cable meets the easel foot and the tower base.
